title: SK Group opens 2-year AI academy with $2,200 monthly allowance
key_facts: SK Group said on Monday 12 Oct 2026 it will launch SK AIGEN, a two-year, full-time, non-degree program for aspiring developers and early-career innovators, focused on using AI to solve real-world problems.
Participants get a stipend of 3 million won (about $2,200) a month for two years, plus training, mentoring and workspace.
Open to people aged 19 to 34; starts March 2027 with about 50 participants.
The program does not guarantee a job at SK or grant a degree, and participants have no obligations afterwards.

Year one is individual or team projects; year two is hands-on experience in the participant's own field, with SK connecting mentors and experts; Seoul National University's AI Institute helps with a humanities perspective and career planning.
Run by mySUNI, SK's in-house corporate training platform; applicants chosen on willingness to solve problems and growth potential, not academic background or major.
Applications 1-15 Nov 2026; an information session on 28 Oct in Seoul.
SK Chairman Chey Tae-won said in May that training to acquire knowledge quickly and pass exams is being replaced by AI.
